title: The Pass Is Closed
hook: You know why you are here.
scene: You are in Kent. Your mother is in Spokane. The pass is between you. You cannot take it on a permit. You cannot take it alone. You cannot take it until you are good enough. Gracie is on the passenger seat. Mya is beside her. They came because they always come. That is the whole of what you are doing.
debrief: The pass is closed. You know that before the car moves. The cats are with you because they always are.

source.teaching_target: The premise, on the first card. She is here for the license so she can get good enough for the pass. Both cats are with her.
